items.title: Lilly’s Obesity Access Push via Medicare Bridge Might Change The Case For Investing In Eli Lilly (LLY)
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Company recently presented at Morgan Stanley’s Global Healthcare Conference, where executive vice president Ilya Yuffa outlined efforts to expand access to its obesity medicines, including Zepbound and Foundayo, and highlighted broader international growth initiatives. This focus on widening obesity treatment access through consumer advertising, Medicare Bridge support, and global reach underlines how central these therapies have become to Lilly’s long-term business mix.
